subject: mathematics
concept: Real-world fraction and decimal word problems using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student acts out a sharing or measuring scenario with on-screen objects, tracking fraction/decimal amounts
exercise.pictorial: Student draws a bar model to represent a one-step fraction or decimal word problem
exercise.abstract: Student solves a one-step fraction or decimal word problem and explains their reasoning

misconception_flags: cannot decide whether a problem calls for fraction or decimal representation

interest_binding: word problems generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
